english.title: Deal with funds / economic resources owned / held / controlled by designated person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or having reasonable cause to suspect that funds or economic resources, namely **(..DESCRIBE FUNDS OR RESOURCES..), were owned, held or controlled by a person designated under regulation 5, namely **(..SPECIFY DESIGNATED PERSON..), dealt with those funds or economic resources, in that **(..SPECIFY MANNER OF DEALING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(1) and (3) and 31(1)(a) and (d) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
dealt with funds / economic resources
owned / held / controlled by a designated person
knowing / having reasonable cause to suspect
that he / she was dealing with such funds / resources

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
